name: Queendoms
source:
This is the continent of Queendoms, ruled by women.
Men are second-class citizens to them.
What will they do to stop the main character who by fate became the ruler of the most prosperous Queendom?
translation:
这里是女性统治天下的“女王大陆”，
男人在她们眼中不过是二等公民。
当男主角在命运的捉弄下登上了最富庶女王国的王座，女人们将会使出怎样的手段来阻止他？
